messages:
sam: Heads up: console shows /v1/generate p99 spike for the EU region starting ~08:30 UTC. p50/p95 flat. anyone digging?

tess: I saw that too. weirdly the endpoint traffic graph shows a small bump in total qps, not enough to explain 4x tail.

ivor: could be rollup key collapse - we recently added endpoint aliasing to merge stream vs non-stream variants for UI simplicity. Might have merged /v1/generate-stream samples into the same rollup. stream responses have very different latency distribution.

sam: oh yeah, we merged by "route_name" only last week. transport tag (http vs websocket) got dropped in the rollup key.

zara: devops-bot: deployment canary v2.4.0 rolled 2026-03-15T08:20Z -> note: endpoint aliasing feature flag enabled for traffic-weight=15%

ivor: quick check query: ```sql
SELECT transport, stream_enabled, percentile(latency_ms,50) p50, percentile(latency_ms,95) p95, percentile(latency_ms,99) p99, count(*)
FROM telemetry_latency
WHERE canonical_route = '/v1/generate' AND region = 'eu'
  AND time >= now() - interval '45 minutes'
GROUP BY transport, stream_enabled
ORDER BY p99 DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

tess: running -> results: transport=websocket, stream_enabled=true => p99 = 2200ms, p95 = 150ms; transport=http, stream_enabled=false => p99 = 120ms, p95 = 85ms. websock stream sample count is low but tails dominate the merged rollup p99.

sam: so UI rollup showing single p99 is misleading. We should either split by transport or surface sample_origin counts.

ivor: agree. short-term: revert aliasing for endpoint rollups (feature flag) and push a dashboard annotation for the canary window. longer-term: make rollup key include transport+stream flag and add a small badge showing sample counts per slice.

zara: filed UX follow-up ZU-7786 to expose sample-origin breakouts in the latency panel. will toggle feature flag now.

devops-bot: feature-flag toggle request accepted. aliasing.feature_flag -> OFF for canary group.

tess: toggle done. requerying panels, p99 collapsed back to baseline for /v1/generate. will monitor for 20m and then either re-enable with transport in key or keep split.

sam: thanks all. note for runbook: avoid merging stream/non-stream without transport dimension — it's too easy to produce phantom tails. adding follow-up ticket RT-4382 for runbook + dashboard caption.
